units: <cite ref="Pesachim 82a:10">Pes. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>דקא גדיל שיש׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="U01095"><he>שירש׳</he></cite>) if he (the unclean priest) is a ropemaker (who cannot be suspected of neglecting the Temple service from mercenary motives).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 96a:10">B. Kam. 96ᵃ</cite> <he>חופיא ועבדיה שר׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>ועבדינהו שיש׳</he>) if one stole palm leaves made into a broom, and made them into a rope.
